stripe_void_semantics.invoices_during_pause: Stripe marks invoices created while pause_collection.behavior=void as void immediately; amounts are not collectible later.
stripe_void_semantics.resume: Unsetting pause_collection resumes future invoices only; voided invoices stay void. Billing cycle/status remain active unless otherwise changed.
stripe_void_semantics.next_billing_date: pause_collection does not by itself change current_period_end.
stripe_void_semantics.immediate_invoice_on_resume: Not expected from unsetting pause_collection (this is not Subscription Pause status=paused Resume API).
stripe_void_semantics.free_service: Void pause temporarily offers service without collecting those invoices — matches approved exception duration if expiry is enforced.
